text:
sam.jenkins: Heads-up — we need to coordinate a minimal base-image rebuild to remove unused packages, enable non-root, and wire up audit logging + KMS. Targeting a low-impact window Thu 02:00 UTC. Thoughts?

maria.choi: +1. Can we get a quick inventory of what layers currently pull in openssl, python-dev, apt-utils? Those are common extras we can trim.

oscar: I ran trivy last night on the v1 base. Findings: libc6 pending fix (CVE-2026-0456), curl-dev not used, python3-venv safe to remove for non-build images. I'll paste the quick diff later.

ryan.khan: Important: any rebuild must include node that we rotate KMS-encrypted secrets and ensure KMS key policy includes the new image-builder role. If the new image hash changes, the attestation flow needs update.

sec-bot: [automated scan summary] 4 HIGH, 12 MEDIUM on redwood/base:v1. Report uploaded: https://internal.redwood/scan/1789-2026

maria.choi: For RBAC, propose creating a scoped service account image-builder@infra with only iam:SignBlob and kms:Decrypt on the specific key ARN. We should avoid giving broad roles to CI runners.

oscar: Agree. Minimal permissions lloks like:

```yaml
# iam policy fragment
- Effect: Allow
  Action:
    - kms:Decrypt
    - kms:Encrypt
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/x-abcdefgh
```

sam.jenkins: Good. Also need audit logging — make sure the rebuild pipeline sends a provenance statement to audit logs and we keep the SBOM in registry metadata. Anyone on registry retention config?

devex: I can add SBOM generation to the builder step (syft) and push cyclonedx to the registry. Will attach sbom URL to image labels: `org.redwood.sbom_url`.

ryan.khan: For runtime hardening, we should switch default ENTRYPOINT user to non-root and add a `--cap-drop=ALL --cap-add=NET_BIND_SERVICE` note for runtime. Also enable seccomp profile from our hardened set.

oscar: Here's the minimal Dockerfile diff I plan to land:

```dockerfile
FROM scratch as base
COPY --from=debian:stable-slim /usr /usr
# remove apt caches and docs
RUN rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /usr/share/doc /usr/share/man
USER 65532:65532
LABEL org.redwood.sbom_url="https://registry.redwood/sbom/base/v2.cyclone.json"
```

maria.choi: We also need to coordinate with oncall so rollout doesn't trigger false positives in our runtime agent. @oncall-bot can you add a quiet window for Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC?

oncall-bot: Quiet window scheduled: 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. Alerts suppressed for rebuild job IDs prefixed with `rbld-`.

sam.jenkins: Great. Action items: 1) oscar to submit PR for Dockerfile and builder pipeline (trivy & syft) by Tue EOD. 2) devex to add SBOM label and upload step. 3) ryan to prepare KMS policy and attestation changes. 4) maria to prepare RBAC change PR for image-builder role. 5) sec to run pre-rollout vuln triage on the new image.

ryan.khan: I'll also add a small KMS rotation test in CI: `aws kms encrypt/decrypt` against the new key and record logs to audit bucket.

sec-bot: Marking thread as tracked: security/rebuild-coord-1789. Triage checklist added to incident playbook.

maria.choi: One more thing — post-rollout we should run a smoke test that verifies logs export with `audit.log` events for `container.start`, `container.exec`, and `kms.decrypt`. If those aren't present, auto-rollback.

sam.jenkins: Sounds good. If no objections I'll schedule the PR review and can own the rollout coordination. :thumbsup:

oscar: No objections from me, will open PR and tag the reviewers.

ryan.khan: Will review KMS bits.

devex: I'll update the docs and console template for the new non-root requirement.

sam.jenkins: Closing the loop — everyone: drop quick confirmations in thread once your PRs are green.
